about: Every buildable tower. object_class is a base-game Arma 3 class. Static weapons get one AI gunner; infantry towers spawn crew_count soldiers of crew_class. Real projectiles are deleted on firing; damage is scripted so nothing stray hits players. impact_ammo (if set) is a real shell dropped on the target for explosive towers.

columns.name: object_class
columns.desc: static weapon class, or soldier class for infantry

columns.name: crew_class
columns.desc: AI gunner for statics, soldier for infantry

columns.name: pierce
columns.desc: bloons hit per shot (per soldier for infantry)

columns.name: impact_delay_s
columns.desc: shell flight time for splash towers, 0 = instant

columns.name: impact_ammo
columns.desc: real CfgAmmo shell dropped on impact, empty = none

columns.name: mannable
columns.desc: players can take the gun and shoot bloons themselves

rows.name: Dart Squad
rows.blurb: Three riflemen. Cheap, steady, short range.

rows.name: M2 HMG Nest
rows.blurb: Fast .50 cal. Hop on the gun yourself.

rows.name: Sniper
rows.blurb: Sees camo bloons. Hits anywhere on the track.

rows.name: Mk6 Mortar
rows.blurb: Explosive splash. Pops lead. Danger close!
